description: Baseline eval fixture for PP-005: Buaflow's mobile golden stack. Unlike PP-003/PP-004 (always-online web CRUD), this app must work fully offline and reconcile with the server once connectivity returns — see docs/sync-contract.md. Comparable in shape to evidence/../react-fastapi-postgres-crud/evidence/pp-004-eval-fixture.json: same rehearsal/evidence-bundle machinery, a materially different capability (offline-first mobile client + sync API instead of always-online CRUD).

stack.capabilityPack: none — same v1 pack-contract gap PP-004 documented (no capability-based requiresPacks); auth/RBAC and the sync API are built directly into backend/app (see docs/runbook.md)
stack.profile: internal-crud (claude-setup/tests/fixtures/profiles/internal-crud.json) — no dedicated 'mobile/offline' profile exists yet in PP-001's fixture set; using internal-crud is a pragmatic reuse, not a claim that this app's actual profile needs are fully modeled. Flagged as a follow-up, not attempted here.

cleanEnvironmentRehearsal.scope: docker compose down -v, fresh Postgres, alembic upgrade head, seed, docker build --no-cache (mobile web export -> Python runtime), run, health check, sync-API smoke test, web-export smoke test, teardown

migrationRollbackRehearsal.scope: verify schema, alembic downgrade base, verify dropped, alembic upgrade head + seed, verify restored

backendIntegration.note: includes the sync push/pull contract: conflict resolution, ownership boundary on pushes, bearer-token auth

mobileSyncEngineUnit.note: pure client-side sync engine (merge/reconcile/conflict), no device/network needed — includes a regression test for a real mid-flight-edit race bug found and fixed while building this app

e2e.note: includes a genuine offline/online round trip via real browser-context network emulation, not a mocked fetch

readinessCheck.result: PASS (25/25 controls) — every R0-R3 control has real, checked evidence. Two genuine findings along the way, both caught and fixed, not hidden: (1) a real data-loss race bug in the mobile sync hook — a sync triggered immediately after a local mutation could read a stale state snapshot and silently overwrite the just-made edit; caught by tests/e2e/primary-flow.spec.ts and tests/e2e/offline-sync.spec.ts failing for real, root-caused through two wrong fix attempts (a ref mirrored by useEffect, then a React setState 'peek' that doesn't actually run synchronously) before landing on the correct fix (an eagerly-updated ref as the single synchronous source of truth) — see mobile/src/hooks/useTasks.ts's own comment. (2) npm audit found 10 moderate-severity findings in the mobile app's production dependency tree, all tracing to one transitive uuid advisory pulled in by Expo's own iOS-tooling dependency chain; fixed with a targeted npm 'overrides' pin to uuid@^11.1.1, verified the web export and typecheck still pass, not documented-and-ignored — see docs/security-notes.md.
readinessCheck.ciRun: PENDING — filled in after the first push, per this repository's established practice (see PP-003/PP-004's own eval fixtures)
